description: The optional cluster endpoint (Q19) on the HA cluster built as in e2e3a.build, with host A's provider enabled for it and host B's not: opt in at k3s.e2e.test, verify certificates, bridge resolution and ensure-ha-endpoint with the CA reference; stop e2e-k3 and use the hostname; retire e2e-k3; opt out.

inputs.agentA: the dev VM's production-style system unit opute-bootstrap-mcp.service (Rust 0.3.0 release candidate binary, test identity e2e-devvm-agent, test token), with the Rust k3s provider 1.0.2 from the release (e2e-provider-k3s, port 4320)
inputs.agentB: a transient Rust agent e2e-ha-b on port 3031 (e2etool agent start), with its own Rust k3s provider (e2e-provider-k3s-b, port 4321)
inputs.k3s: K3s v1.31.8+k3s1, downloaded by the provider from the K3s GitHub release and checked against its checksums; images pulled by K3s from public registries

requirements.spec: published docs, host-agents c9f9e775 (v0.2.4) site/public/docs/availability/ (test record 2026-09-25)
requirements.requirement: Three Incus server containers provisioned and configured through typed Host Agent operations as a K3s cluster with embedded-etcd
requirements.scenario: 3 Ready servers and 3 etcd members after joining through the sealed handshake
Secret-bearing input: the K3s join token reaches no Host Agent state, journal or client-visible record; it crosses hosts only sealed to the destination's key

requirements.requirement: The HA registration endpoint is optional and off by default
requirements.scenario: The capability is listed only on the host whose provider enables it; the cluster built without opting in has no certificate name, resolver entry or record for the hostname

requirements.requirement: An opted-in endpoint is stable across server loss
requirements.scenario: Opting in at k3s.e2e.test: every server's certificate lists it, it resolves on the bridge to the three servers, ensure-ha-endpoint verifies it with the CA reference (no UnknownIssuer), a repeat restarts nothing; with e2e-k3 stopped a read and a typed write through the hostname succeed and the endpoint still verifies
Retiring the dead e2e-k3 removes it from resolution in the same operation, and the endpoint still verifies

requirements.requirement: Opting out is a typed operation
requirements.scenario: After opting out no certificate, resolver entry or record names the hostname, the CA reference resolves to nothing, a client addressing a server directly still works, and a repeat reports unchanged

requirements.requirement: Changing TLS names is an explicit, bounded effect
requirements.scenario: Opting in and out restarted the Ready servers one at a time, each Ready again before the next (the operation's own order); a server that does not return is covered by the unit test

steps.guest: chown -R opute /home/opute/.config/opute-e2e && for p in 4320:e2e-provider-k3s 4321:e2e-provider-k3s-b; do systemd-run --collect --unit=${p#*:} --uid=opute --gid=opute --setenv=HOME=/home/opute --setenv=OPUTE_PROVIDER_PORT=${p%%:*} $( [ ${p%%:*} = 4320 ] && echo --setenv=OPUTE_K3S_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT=enabled ) --property=Restart=no /opt/opute-e2e/providers/opute-provider-k3s || exit 1; done && python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start b --port 3031 --id e2e-ha-b --env OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN='${SECRET:tokenB}' >/dev/null && for i in $(seq 60); do ss -ltnH 'sport = :4320' | grep -q . && ss -ltnH 'sport = :4321' | grep -q . && break; sleep 0.5; done; ss -ltnH '( sport = :4320 or sport = :4321 )' | wc -l

python3 -c 'import sys, time, json; sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/opute-e2e/guest"); import mcpwire
for i in range(120):
    r = mcpwire.mcp(3014, sys.argv[1], "tools/list", request_id=i + 1)
    names = [t["name"] for t in ((r.get("body") or {}).get("result") or {}).get("tools") or []]
    if "opute.capability.kubernetes.provision" in names: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
print(json.dumps({"listed": "opute.capability.kubernetes.provision" in names, "tools": len(names), "polls": i + 1}))' '${TOKEN}'

python3 -c 'import sys, time, json; sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/opute-e2e/guest"); import mcpwire
for i in range(120):
    r = mcpwire.mcp(3031, sys.argv[1], "tools/list", request_id=i + 1)
    names = [t["name"] for t in ((r.get("body") or {}).get("result") or {}).get("tools") or []]
    if "opute.capability.kubernetes.provision" in names: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
print(json.dumps({"listed": "opute.capability.kubernetes.provision" in names, "tools": len(names), "polls": i + 1}))' '${SECRET:tokenB}'

{ grep -a -r -o -F '${K3S_TOKEN}' /home/opute/.config/opute /tmp/e2e-agents/b 2>/dev/null; for u in opute-bootstrap-mcp e2e-agent-b e2e-provider-k3s e2e-provider-k3s-b; do journalctl -u $u --no-pager -o cat; done | grep -o -F '${K3S_TOKEN}'; } | wc -l

python3 -c 'import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/opute-e2e/guest"); import mcpwire
r = mcpwire.mcp(3014, sys.argv[1], "tools/list")
names = [t["name"] for t in ((r.get("body") or {}).get("result") or {}).get("tools") or []]
print(json.dumps({"listed": "opute.capability.kubernetes.ensure-cluster-endpoint" in names}))' '${TOKEN}'

r = mcpwire.mcp(3031, sys.argv[1], "tools/list")
names = [t["name"] for t in ((r.get("body") or {}).get("result") or {}).get("tools") or []]
print(json.dumps({"listed": "opute.capability.kubernetes.ensure-cluster-endpoint" in names}))' '${SECRET:tokenB}'

ip=$(incus list e2e-k1 -f json | python3 -c "import json,sys; i=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]; print([a['address'] for a in i['state']['network']['eth0']['addresses'] if a['family']=='inet'][0])"); echo | timeout 10 openssl s_client -connect $ip:6443 -servername k3s.e2e.test 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -ext subjectAltName 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'DNS:k3s.e2e.test'; ip=$(incus list e2e-k2 -f json | python3 -c "import json,sys; i=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]; print([a['address'] for a in i['state']['network']['eth0']['addresses'] if a['family']=='inet'][0])"); echo | timeout 10 openssl s_client -connect $ip:6443 -servername k3s.e2e.test 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -ext subjectAltName 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'DNS:k3s.e2e.test'; ip=$(incus list e2e-k3 -f json | python3 -c "import json,sys; i=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]; print([a['address'] for a in i['state']['network']['eth0']['addresses'] if a['family']=='inet'][0])"); echo | timeout 10 openssl s_client -connect $ip:6443 -servername k3s.e2e.test 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -ext subjectAltName 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'DNS:k3s.e2e.test'; incus exec e2e-k1 -- getent ahostsv4 k3s.e2e.test | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; incus network get incusbr0 raw.dnsmasq | grep -c 'host-record=k3s.e2e.test,'

ip=$(incus list e2e-k1 -f json | python3 -c "import json,sys; i=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]; print([a['address'] for a in i['state']['network']['eth0']['addresses'] if a['family']=='inet'][0])"); echo | timeout 10 openssl s_client -connect $ip:6443 -servername k3s.e2e.test 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -ext subjectAltName 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'DNS:k3s.e2e.test'; ip=$(incus list e2e-k2 -f json | python3 -c "import json,sys; i=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]; print([a['address'] for a in i['state']['network']['eth0']['addresses'] if a['family']=='inet'][0])"); echo | timeout 10 openssl s_client -connect $ip:6443 -servername k3s.e2e.test 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -ext subjectAltName 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'DNS:k3s.e2e.test'; ip=$(incus list e2e-k3 -f json | python3 -c "import json,sys; i=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]; print([a['address'] for a in i['state']['network']['eth0']['addresses'] if a['family']=='inet'][0])"); echo | timeout 10 openssl s_client -connect $ip:6443 -servername k3s.e2e.test 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -ext subjectAltName 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'DNS:k3s.e2e.test';
incus exec e2e-k1 -- getent ahostsv4 k3s.e2e.test | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; incus network get incusbr0 raw.dnsmasq | grep -c 'host-record=k3s.e2e.test,'

incus exec e2e-k1 -- sh -c 'sed "s#https://127.0.0.1:6443#https://k3s.e2e.test:6443#" /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml > /tmp/ep.yaml; start=$(date +%s); for i in $(seq 60); do k3s kubectl --kubeconfig /tmp/ep.yaml get --raw /version >/dev/null 2>&1 && k3s kubectl --kubeconfig /tmp/ep.yaml create configmap e2e-through-endpoint -n default --from-literal=via=endpoint >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done; echo seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - start )); k3s kubectl --kubeconfig /tmp/ep.yaml get configmap e2e-through-endpoint -n default -o jsonpath={.data.via}; rm -f /tmp/ep.yaml'

incus exec e2e-k1 -- getent ahostsv4 k3s.e2e.test | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; incus network get incusbr0 raw.dnsmasq | grep -c 'host-record=k3s.e2e.test,'; incus exec e2e-k1 -- getent ahostsv4 k3s.e2e.test | awk -v ip='${K3_IP}' '$1 == ip' | wc -l

ip=$(incus list e2e-k1 -f json | python3 -c "import json,sys; i=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]; print([a['address'] for a in i['state']['network']['eth0']['addresses'] if a['family']=='inet'][0])"); echo | timeout 10 openssl s_client -connect $ip:6443 -servername k3s.e2e.test 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -ext subjectAltName 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'DNS:k3s.e2e.test'; ip=$(incus list e2e-k2 -f json | python3 -c "import json,sys; i=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]; print([a['address'] for a in i['state']['network']['eth0']['addresses'] if a['family']=='inet'][0])"); echo | timeout 10 openssl s_client -connect $ip:6443 -servername k3s.e2e.test 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -ext subjectAltName 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'DNS:k3s.e2e.test';
incus exec e2e-k1 -- getent ahostsv4 k3s.e2e.test | wc -l; incus network get incusbr0 raw.dnsmasq | grep -c 'k3s.e2e.test'
incus exec e2e-k1 -- k3s kubectl -n kube-system get configmap opute-cluster-endpoint 2>&1 | grep -c NotFound
incus exec e2e-k1 -- k3s kubectl get nodes -o name | wc -l

cleanup.guest: systemctl stop e2e-provider-k3s e2e-provider-k3s-b 2>/dev/null; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove b >/dev/null; for n in e2e-k1 e2e-k2 e2e-k3; do incus delete -f $n 2>/dev/null; done; incus storage volume list default -f csv | awk -F, '$1=="image"{print $2}' | xargs -r -I{} incus storage volume delete default image/{}; rm -rf /home/opute/.config/opute-e2e /opt/opute-e2e/providers; true
incus network get incusbr0 raw.dnsmasq | grep -q opute-cluster-endpoint && incus network unset incusbr0 raw.dnsmasq; true
